scope: Graded sleeve cut-panel selection from lower forearm to upper arm. Reduce excessive resting support gap by up to 40 mm, protect actual shoulder/cuff spatial regions. Internal sewn panel edges may move with their cloth rather than inheriting all physical-attachment pin protection. One shared editable key on jacket and evaluated sewing cage; original controls/UVs/keys/weights/rig/animation/maps/materials retained. Proposed rest stand-off is not animated collision proof.

posed_fit.modifier: Sleeve cotton follows posed arm contours
posed_fit.target: Torso fit | isolated anatomical arm contact
posed_fit.placement: After armature and existing cloth rounding, before existing outside-body constraint. Graded forearm/elbow/upper-arm mask with shoulder and cuff spatial protection. A hidden source-sharing contact object retains faces with combined arm-bone influence at least 0.65, preventing attraction to the torso. This is authored anatomical fitting, not physical cloth simulation.

raglan_join_ease.method: Shortest rest mesh-edge distance from the connected sleeve/torso join. Keep join volume free and blend anatomical fitting over the next 55 mm; cuff and shoulder spatial protections remain.

body_taper.method: Native arm-weight selection; smooth perpendicular centerline from thirteen weighted cross sections along each existing bone direction. Graded inward radial excess reduction, capped at 12 mm, toward an authored adult upper-arm/forearm taper. Shoulder and wrist ends fade to zero. Original support controls/UVs/keys/weights and bones retained; no claim of measured human scan anatomy.

elbow_folds.method: Three shallow outward rounded gathers on the concave elbow/upper-forearm side, before subdivision after posed anatomical fitting. Authored native cloth geometry follows the existing walk; not a physical cloth simulation.
